span.p:
Single-Page Application
[React 19 · Vite · nginx :4200]
Catalog, detail, cart, orders, admin.
Reverse-proxies both APIs, so the
browser sees one origin and there
is no CORS to configure.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
catalog-service
[Spring Boot 4 · Java 25 · :8081]
Source of truth for products,
prices, stock and reservations.
Hexagonal: domain / application /
infrastructure

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
order-service
[Spring Boot 4 · Java 25 · :8082]
Carts and orders. Copies price and
label onto order lines at checkout,
so a past order never changes.
Hexagonal: same layout

[OIDC issuer · :8080]

machine token order-service uses
for /internal/**
